drivers.text: Political tensions and profit-taking pushed PSX below 178,000, making sentiment cautious into the next week.
KSE-100 fell nearly 400 points on geopolitical concerns and volatile trade, adding near-term pressure.
Weekly SPI inflation dipped 0.11 percent, a mildly supportive signal for rate expectations.
Rupee gained 0.01 percent to 276.42 per dollar, a small currency stability positive.
IMF seeking over 100 changes to the sovereign wealth fund law is a governance overhang with uncertain timing.
